contentEn:
Why This Coquitlam Homeowner Replaced the Bathtub

The homeowners had a 1990s alcove bathtub that was stained, slow to drain, and difficult to step over. With two seniors visiting regularly, they wanted a curbless entry that was safe for all ages. The property is a 1998 townhouse in Coquitlam's Westwood Plateau neighbourhood.

They called Reno Stars for an in-home assessment. The quote included: scope review, fixed price, BC-code-compliant waterproofing, and a written 3-year workmanship warranty.

Real Budget: $14,000 – $17,000

Here is what the $14,000–$17,000 investment covered for this Coquitlam shower conversion:

  • Demolition: Remove existing bathtub, tile surround, old plumbing valves, and waterproofing layer — hauled to designated Metro Vancouver disposal.
  • Plumbing: Replace drain assembly with a 2-inch shower drain. Pressure-test rough-in before tiling. Install new pressure-balance shower valve.
  • Waterproofing: Full Schluter-Kerdi membrane system on shower walls and floor. Mortar pre-slope to linear drain. Water test before tile goes down.
  • Tiling: 24×48 large-format porcelain on shower walls. 12×24 hexagon mosaic on floor. Grout and silicone at all movement joints.
  • Hardware: Fixed glass panel and swinging door. Matte black hardware package: shower head, controls, and built-in soap niche.
  • Electrical: New vanity lighting and exhaust fan upgrade to meet BC Building Code.
  • Finishing: Paint, baseboard trim, and final clean.

The main cost driver was the large-format tile and custom glass door — adding roughly $2,000 over a basic fiberglass surround quote they had received elsewhere.

Waterproofing: Why the Membrane Matters

A common shortcut in tub-to-shower conversions is liquid waterproofing (RedGard brushed on). That works for a rental suite with low moisture exposure. For a primary bathroom in a townhouse with shared walls, the correct standard is a continuous membrane — Schluter-Kerdi — installed behind the tile on walls and floor.

For this Coquitlam project, the Reno Stars crew installed Kerdi membrane from the shower floor up to 84 inches on all walls. The drain was a Kerdi drain flange assembly, creating a watertight ring. The floor had a pre-sloped mortar bed directing water to the drain before the membrane was installed.

This approach meets BC Building Code Section 3.7 (wet locations) and carries the Reno Stars 3-year warranty on workmanship.

Timeline: 3.5 Weeks from Demo to Handover

Day 1: Demolition and plumbing rough-in.
Days 2–5: Membrane installation and water test.
Days 6–14: Tile work (walls first, then floor grout).
Days 15–17: Glass hardware installation.
Day 18: Final inspection, caulking, and clean.

The project finished on day 19 — half a day ahead of schedule. The homeowners were able to use the shower the following morning.

What a Coquitlam Shower Conversion Costs in 2026

Metro Vancouver market rates for a professional tub-to-shower conversion range from $10,000 to $22,000, depending on tile selection, glass type, and whether the floor plan requires drain relocation. The key variable is whether the existing drain location suits a shower layout — moving a drain adds $2,000–$5,000 in plumbing.

At $14,000–$17,000, this Coquitlam project is mid-range for a professionally waterproofed conversion with quality finishes. It does not include floor tile replacement beyond the shower zone, which would add $800–$2,500 depending on the area.

Book Your Coquitlam Bathroom Assessment

Every Reno Stars bathroom project starts with a free in-home consultation — measurements, photos, and a written estimate with specific line items. No vague quotes.

To schedule yours: Contact Reno Stars. We serve Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, and all of Metro Vancouver.

為什麼這位高貴林業主選擇拆除浴缸

業主家中的1990年代凹槽式浴缸已出現污漬、排水緩慢，且进出困难。家中有年長者經常来访，無障礙進出的淋浴間成為剛需。該房產位於高貴林西Wood Plateau 社區，建於1998年的聯排別墅。

業主聯繫聚星裝修進行上門評估。報價包含：工程範圍說明、固定價格、符合BC建築規範的防水工程，以及書面3年工程保修。

真實預算：14,000至17,000加元

14,000至17,000加元的預算涵蓋以下範圍：

  • 拆除工程：拆除現有浴缸、瓷磚貼面、舊閥門及防水層，運往指定Metro Vancouver廢棄物處理站。
  • 管道工程：將排水組件更換為2英寸淋浴地漏。在瓷磚鋪設前進行壓力測試。安裝壓力平衡淋浴閥。
  • 防水工程：淋浴間牆面及地面全面鋪設Schluter-Kerdi防水膜系統。砂漿預斜層至線性地漏。在防水膜鋪設前進行測試。
  • 瓷磚工程：24×48大規格瓷磚鋪設淋浴間牆面。12×24六邊形馬賽克鋪設地面。所有活動接縫處填縫及硅膠密封。
  • 五金件：固定玻璃面板及開門。啞光黑五金套裝：花灑頭、控制閥及嵌入式肥皂盒。
  • 電氣工程：浴室櫃照明升級及排氣扇升級至符合BC建築規範標準。
  • 收尾工程：油漆、底板及最終清潔。

主要成本驱动因素是大規格瓷磚和定制玻璃門——比業主收到的其他基本玻璃纖維報價高出約2,000加元。

防水：為什麼防水膜至關重要

浴缸改淋浴常見的簡化做法是液體防水（刷塗RedGard）。這對於出租套房等潮濕暴露較低的環境尚可接受。對於帶共有牆的聯排別瘤主衛浴，正確做法是使用連續防水膜——Schluter-Kerdi——安裝於瓷磚背面的牆面及地面。

在本高贵林项目中，聚星装修团队将Kerdi防水膜从淋浴间地面安装至所有墙壁84英寸高度。地漏采用Kerdi排水法兰组件，形成防水密封圈。地板采用预斜砂浆基层，在安装防水膜前将水引导至排水口。

该做法符合BC建筑规范第3.7节（潮湿区域）规定，并享有聚星装修3年工程保修。

工期：拆除到交付約4週

第1天：拆除及管道預裝。
第2-5天：防水膜安裝及測試。
第6-14天：瓷磚工程（先牆面，後地面填縫）。
第15-17天：玻璃五金安裝。
第18天：最終檢驗、硅膠密封及清潔。

項目在第19天完工——比計劃提前半天。業主在次日清晨即可使用淋浴間。

2026年高貴林淋浴間改造的市場價格

Metro Vancouver專業浴缸換淋浴工程的市場價格約為10,000至22,000加元，視瓷磚選擇、玻璃類型及是否需要移動地漏而異。關鍵變量是現有排水位置是否適合淋浴佈局——移動地漏需額外支付2,000至5,000加元管道費用。

本項目造價14,000至17,000加元，屬於專業防水施工及優質飾面的中高檔區間。如需更換淋浴區外的地面瓷磚，額外費用約為800至2,500加元，視面積而定。

預約您的免費評估

每個聚星裝修衛浴項目均以免費上門諮詢開始——包括測量、拍照及包含具體項目的書面估算。拒絕模糊報價。

立即預約：聯繫聚星裝修。我們服務高貴林、滿橋、高貴林港及整個Metro Vancouver地區。
